mapper.select: SELECT stock,redis_inventory_initialized FROM product_sku WHERE id=#{sku}
SELECT stock,redis_inventory_initialized FROM product_sku WHERE id=#{sku} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE product_sku SET redis_inventory_initialized=TRUE WHERE id=#{sku}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_sku WHERE redis_inventory_initialized=TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE order_submit_trace SET mode=#{mode} WHERE trace_id=#{id} AND status='INIT' AND reserve_status='NONE'
UPDATE order_submit_trace SET reserve_status='RESERVING',version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),next_check_at=#{next} WHERE trace_id=#{id} AND status='INIT' AND reserve_status='NONE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_submit_trace WHERE trace_id=#{id} AND status='INIT' AND reserve_status='RESERVING' AND next_check_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.update: UPDATE order_submit_trace SET reserve_status='RESERVED' WHERE trace_id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND reserve_status='RESERVING'
UPDATE order_submit_trace SET reserve_status=#{state},next_check_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE trace_id=#{id} AND reserve_status=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT o.submit_trace_id AS trace_id,t.reserve_status FROM customer_order o LEFT JOIN order_submit_trace t ON t.trace_id=o.submit_trace_id WHERE o.id=#{order}
SELECT order_id,sku_id FROM order_inventory_return WHERE order_id=#{order} AND completed=FALSE ORDER BY sku_id
SELECT order_id,sku_id FROM order_inventory_return WHERE completed=FALSE ORDER BY created_at,order_id,sku_id LIMIT 50
SELECT * FROM order_inventory_return WHERE order_id=#{order} AND sku_id=#{sku} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE order_inventory_return SET completed=TRUE WHERE order_id=#{order} AND sku_id=#{sku} AND completed=FALSE
UPDATE order_submit_trace SET reserve_status='RETURN_PENDING' WHERE order_id=#{order} AND reserve_status IN ('CONFIRM_PENDING','CONFIRMED')

UPDATE order_submit_trace SET reserve_status='RETURNED' WHERE order_id=#{order} AND reserve_status='RETURN_PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_inventory_return r WHERE r.order_id=#{order} AND r.completed=FALSE)
